description: attestations validly BIP-322 signed by burn key #1 for its mainnet, testnet or regtest address (SPEC §7.1 step 3): the message selects testnet or signet only by that exact network value and mainnet otherwise, so each case's reason, with the verifier in test mode where test_mode says so, is bad_request for an address of another network, before network_testmode, network_testmode for a testnet address outside test mode, and null for the controls and for a mainnet address under any other network value; a case's builder says whether a builder writes its extensions for its address or refuses them, and it writes no network value but mainnet, testnet or signet
